verses.he: שִׁ֥יר מִזְמֹ֗ור לִבְנֵ֫י קֹ֥רַח לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־מָחֲלַ֣ת לְעַנֹּ֑ות מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְהֵימָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃
verses.ar: تَسْبِيحَةٌ. مَزْمُورٌ لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ٱلْعُودِ» لِلْغِنَاءِ. قَصِيدَةٌ لِهَيْمَانَ ٱلْأَزْرَاحِيِّ
verses.en: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Leader; upon Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
verses.kjv: A Song [or] Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
verses.web: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite.

verses.he: יְ֭הוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י יֹום־צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: يَارَبُّ إِلَهَ خَلَاصِي، بِٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱللَّيْلِ صَرَخْتُ أَمَامَكَ،
verses.en: O LORD, God of my salvation, what time I cry in the night before Thee,
verses.kjv: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day [and] night before thee:
verses.web: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

verses.ar: فَلْتَأْتِ قُدَّامَكَ صَلَاتِي. أَمِلْ أُذُنَكَ إِلَى صُرَاخِي،
verses.en: Let my prayer come before Thee, incline Thine ear unto my cry.
verses.kjv: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.web: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

verses.he: כִּֽי־שָֽׂבְעָ֣ה בְרָעֹ֣ות נַפְשִׁ֑י וְחַיַּ֗י לִשְׁאֹ֥ול הִגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ شَبِعَتْ مِنَ ٱلْمَصَائِبِ نَفْسِي، وَحَيَاتِي إِلَى ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ دَنَتْ.
verses.en: For my soul is sated with troubles, and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.web: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

verses.he: נֶ֭חְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־יֹ֣ורְדֵי בֹ֑ור הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּגֶ֣בֶר אֵֽין־אֱיָֽל׃
verses.ar: حُسِبْتُ مِثْلَ ٱلْمُنْحَدِرِينَ إِلَى ٱلْجُبِّ. صِرْتُ كَرَجُلٍ لَا قُوَّةَ لَهُ.
verses.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit; I am become as a man that hath no help;
verses.kjv: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man [that hath] no strength:
verses.web: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

verses.he: בַּמֵּתִ֗ים חָ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּמֹ֤ו חֲלָלִ֨ים ׀ שֹׁ֥כְבֵי קֶ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֣א זְכַרְתָּ֣ם עֹ֑וד וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה מִיָּדְךָ֥ נִגְזָֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: بَيْنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ فِرَاشِي مِثْلُ ٱلْقَتْلَى ٱلْمُضْطَجِعِينَ فِي ٱلْقَبْرِ، ٱلَّذِينَ لَا تَذْكُرُهُمْ بَعْدُ، وَهُمْ مِنْ يَدِكَ ٱنْقَطَعُوا.
verses.en: Set apart among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom Thou rememberest no more; and they are cut off from Thy hand.
verses.kjv: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.web: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

verses.ar: وَضَعْتَنِي فِي ٱلْجُبِّ ٱلْأَسْفَلِ، فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ، فِي أَعْمَاقٍ.
verses.en: Thou hast laid me in the nethermost pit, in dark places, in the deeps.
verses.kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.web: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

verses.he: עָ֭לַי סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְכָל־מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗יךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.ar: عَلَيَّ ٱسْتَقَرَّ غَضَبُكَ، وَبِكُلِّ تَيَّارَاتِكَ ذَلَّلْتَنِي. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and all Thy waves Thou pressest down. Selah
verses.kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted [me] with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.web: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

verses.he: הִרְחַ֥קְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי שַׁתַּ֣נִי תֹועֵבֹ֣ות לָ֑מֹו כָּ֝לֻ֗א וְלֹ֣א אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.ar: أَبْعَدْتَ عَنِّي مَعَارِفِي. جَعَلْتَنِي رِجْسًا لَهُمْ. أُغْلِقَ عَلَيَّ فَمَا أَخْرُجُ.
verses.en: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them; I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: [I am] shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.web: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

verses.he: עֵינִ֥י דָאֲבָ֗ה מִנִּ֫י עֹ֥נִי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־יֹ֑ום שִׁטַּ֖חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ כַפָּֽי׃
verses.ar: عَيْنِي ذَابَتْ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ. دَعَوْتُكَ يَارَبُّ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ. بَسَطْتُ إِلَيْكَ يَدَيَّ.
verses.en: Mine eye languisheth by reason of affliction; I have called upon Thee, O LORD, every day, I have spread forth my hands unto Thee.
verses.kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.web: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.

verses.he: הֲלַמֵּתִ֥ים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּ֑לֶא אִם־רְ֝פָאִ֗ים יָק֤וּמוּ ׀ יֹוד֬וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.ar: أَفَلَعَلَّكَ لِلْأَمْوَاتِ تَصْنَعُ عَجَائِبَ؟ أَمِ ٱلْأَخِيلَةُ تَقُومُ تُمَجِّدُكَ؟ سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Wilt Thou work wonders for the dead? Or shall the shades arise and give Thee thanks? Selah
verses.kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise [and] praise thee? Selah.
verses.web: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

verses.ar: هَلْ يُحَدَّثُ فِي ٱلْقَبْرِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، أَوْ بِحَقِّكَ فِي ٱلْهَلَاكِ؟
verses.en: Shall Thy mercy be declared in the grave? or Thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.kjv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? [or] thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.web: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

verses.he: הֲיִוָּדַ֣ע בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צִדְקָתְךָ֗ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ נְשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.ar: هَلْ تُعْرَفُ فِي ٱلظُّلْمَةِ عَجَائِبُكَ، وَبِرُّكَ فِي أَرْضِ ٱلنِّسْيَانِ؟
verses.en: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? and Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.web: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה שִׁוַּ֑עְתִּי וּ֝בַבֹּ֗קֶר תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י תְקַדְּמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَإِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ صَرَخْتُ، وَفِي ٱلْغَدَاةِ صَلَاتِي تَتَقَدَّمُكَ.
verses.en: But as for me, unto Thee, O LORD, do I cry, and in the morning doth my prayer come to meet Thee.
verses.kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.web: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

verses.he: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּזְנַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֑י תַּסְתִּ֖יר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.ar: لِمَاذَا يَارَبُّ تَرْفُضُ نَفْسِي؟ لِمَاذَا تَحْجُبُ وَجْهَكَ عَنِّي؟
verses.en: LORD, why castest Thou off my soul? Why hidest Thou Thy face from me?
verses.kjv: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? [why] hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.web: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

verses.he: עָ֘נִ֤י אֲנִ֣י וְגֹוֵ֣עַ מִנֹּ֑עַר נָשָׂ֖אתִי אֵמֶ֣יךָ אָפֽוּנָה׃
verses.ar: أَنَا مِسْكِينٌ وَمُسَلِّمُ ٱلرُّوحِ مُنْذُ صِبَايَ. ٱحْتَمَلْتُ أَهْوَالَكَ. تَحَيَّرْتُ.
verses.en: I am afflicted and at the point of death from my youth up; I have borne Thy terrors, I am distracted.
verses.kjv: I [am] afflicted and ready to die from [my] youth up: [while] I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.web: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

verses.en: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.kjv: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.web: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

verses.he: סַבּ֣וּנִי כַ֭מַּיִם כָּל־הַיֹּ֑ום הִקִּ֖יפוּ עָלַ֣י יָֽחַד׃
verses.ar: أَحَاطَتْ بِي كَٱلْمِيَاهِ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ. ٱكْتَنَفَتْنِي مَعًا.
verses.en: They came round about me like water all the day; they compassed me about together.
verses.kjv: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.web: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

verses.he: הִרְחַ֣קְתָּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי אֹהֵ֣ב וָרֵ֑עַ מְֽיֻדָּעַ֥י מַחְשָֽׁךְ׃
verses.ar: أَبْعَدْتَ عَنِّي مُحِبًّا وَصَاحِبًا. مَعَارِفِي فِي ٱلظُّلْمَةِ.
verses.en: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, [and] mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.web: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
